headline_marked: [[Google Play Store]] adds Venmo as a payment option for US users
headline: Google Play Store adds Venmo as a payment option for US users
summary: Android users can now link their Venmo accounts to make purchases on the Google Play Store, using either their Venmo balance or a linked payment method.
details: Google is expanding payment options on its Play Store by adding Venmo. This new integration allows users in the US to link their Venmo accounts for purchases.
Users can choose to pay using their Venmo balance or any payment method already linked to their Venmo account. This offers a more flexible payment experience for Android users.
The feature is available in the US and joins other popular payment services like Cash App and PayPal on the Play Store. Major credit cards are also accepted.
To set up Venmo, users need to navigate to the Payment Methods section within the Google Play Store settings. The integration aims to provide a secure and convenient payment alternative.
